chapter.title_en: The Yoga of Knowledge and Realisation
chapter.summary_en: Chapter 7: The Yoga of Knowledge and Realisation — 30 verses
chapter.colophon_sa: इति श्रीमद्भगवद्गीतासु उपनिषत्सु ब्रह्मविद्यायां योगशास्त्रे श्रीकृष्णार्जुनसंवादे ज्ञानविज्ञानयोगः नाम 7ोऽध्यायः ॥ 7 ॥

verses.speaker: krishna
verses.deva:
श्री भगवानुवाच

मय्यासक्तमनाः पार्थ योगं युञ्जन्मदाश्रयः।

असंशयं समग्रं मां यथा ज्ञास्यसि तच्छृणु।।7.1।।
verses.iast:
śrī bhagavānuvāca

mayyāsaktamanāḥ pārtha yogaṃ yuñjanmadāśrayaḥ|

asaṃśayaṃ samagraṃ māṃ yathā jñāsyasi tacchṛṇu||7.1||
verses.en: With the mind intent on Me, O son of Prithâ, taking refuge in Me, and practising Yoga, how thou shalt without doubt know Me fully, that do thou hear.

verses.deva:
ज्ञानं तेऽहं सविज्ञानमिदं वक्ष्याम्यशेषतः।

यज्ज्ञात्वा नेह भूयोऽन्यज्ज्ञातव्यमवशिष्यते।।7.2।।
verses.iast:
jñānaṃ te'haṃ savijñānamidaṃ vakṣyāmyaśeṣataḥ|

yajjñātvā neha bhūyo'nyajjñātavyamavaśiṣyate||7.2||
verses.en: I shall tell you in full, of knowledge, speculative and practical, knowing which, nothing more here remains to be known.

verses.deva:
मनुष्याणां सहस्रेषु कश्िचद्यतति सिद्धये।

यततामपि सिद्धानां कश्िचन्मां वेत्ति तत्त्वतः।।7.3।।
verses.iast:
manuṣyāṇāṃ sahasreṣu kaśicadyatati siddhaye|

yatatāmapi siddhānāṃ kaśicanmāṃ vetti tattvataḥ||7.3||
verses.en: One, perchance, in thousands of men, strives for perfection; and one perchance, among the blessed ones, striving thus, knows Me in reality.

word_meanings.meaning: of those who have achieved perfection

verses.deva:
भूमिरापोऽनलो वायुः खं मनो बुद्धिरेव च।

अहङ्कार इतीयं मे भिन्ना प्रकृतिरष्टधा।।7.4।।
verses.iast:
bhūmirāpo'nalo vāyuḥ khaṃ mano buddhireva ca|

ahaṅkāra itīyaṃ me bhinnā prakṛtiraṣṭadhā||7.4||
verses.en: Bhumi (earth), Ap (water), Anala (fire), Vâyu (air), Kha (ether), mind, intellect, and egoism: thus is My Prakriti divided eight-fold.

verses.deva:
अपरेयमितस्त्वन्यां प्रकृतिं विद्धि मे पराम्।

जीवभूतां महाबाहो ययेदं धार्यते जगत्।।7.5।।
verses.iast:
apareyamitastvanyāṃ prakṛtiṃ viddhi me parām|

jīvabhūtāṃ mahābāho yayedaṃ dhāryate jagat||7.5||
verses.en: This is the lower (Prakriti). But different from it, know thou, O mighty-armed, My higher Prakriti—the principle of self-consciousness, by which this universe is sustained.

verses.deva:
एतद्योनीनि भूतानि सर्वाणीत्युपधारय।

अहं कृत्स्नस्य जगतः प्रभवः प्रलयस्तथा।।7.6।।
verses.iast:
etadyonīni bhūtāni sarvāṇītyupadhāraya|

ahaṃ kṛtsnasya jagataḥ prabhavaḥ pralayastathā||7.6||
verses.en: Know that these (two Prakritis) are the womb of all beings. I am the origin and dissolution of the whole universe.

word_meanings.meaning: these two (energies) are the source of

verses.deva:
मत्तः परतरं नान्यत्किञ्चिदस्ति धनञ्जय।

मयि सर्वमिदं प्रोतं सूत्रे मणिगणा इव।।7.7।।
verses.iast:
mattaḥ parataraṃ nānyatkiñcidasti dhanañjaya|

mayi sarvamidaṃ protaṃ sūtre maṇigaṇā iva||7.7||
verses.en: Beyond Me, O Dhananjaya, there is naught. All this is strung in Me, as a row of jewels on a thread.

verses.deva:
रसोऽहमप्सु कौन्तेय प्रभास्मि शशिसूर्ययोः।

प्रणवः सर्ववेदेषु शब्दः खे पौरुषं नृषु।।7.8।।
verses.iast:
raso'hamapsu kaunteya prabhāsmi śaśisūryayoḥ|

praṇavaḥ sarvavedeṣu śabdaḥ khe pauruṣaṃ nṛṣu||7.8||
verses.en: I am the sapidity in waters, O son of Kunti; I, the radiance in the moon and the sun; I am the Om in all the Vedas, sound in Akâsha, and manhood in men.

word_meanings.meaning: of the moon and the sun

verses.deva:
पुण्यो गन्धः पृथिव्यां च तेजश्चास्मि विभावसौ।

जीवनं सर्वभूतेषु तपश्चास्मि तपस्विषु।।7.9।।
verses.iast:
puṇyo gandhaḥ pṛthivyāṃ ca tejaścāsmi vibhāvasau|

jīvanaṃ sarvabhūteṣu tapaścāsmi tapasviṣu||7.9||
verses.en: I am the sweet fragrance in earth, and the brilliance in fire am I; the life in all beings, and the austerity am I in ascetics.

verses.deva:
बीजं मां सर्वभूतानां विद्धि पार्थ सनातनम्।

बुद्धिर्बुद्धिमतामस्मि तेजस्तेजस्विनामहम्।।7.10।।
verses.iast:
bījaṃ māṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ viddhi pārtha sanātanam|

buddhirbuddhimatāmasmi tejastejasvināmaham||7.10||
verses.en: Know Me, O son of Prithâ, as the eternal seed of all beings. I am the intellect of the intelligent, and the heroism of the heroic.

verses.deva:
बलं बलवतां चाहं कामरागविवर्जितम्।

धर्माविरुद्धो भूतेषु कामोऽस्मि भरतर्षभ।।7.11।।
verses.iast:
balaṃ balavatāṃ cāhaṃ kāmarāgavivarjitam|

dharmāviruddho bhūteṣu kāmo'smi bharatarṣabha||7.11||
verses.en: Of the strong, I am the strength devoid of desire and attachment. I am, O bull among the Bhâratas, desire in beings, unopposed to Dharma.

word_meanings.meaning: Arjun, the best of the Bharats

verses.deva:
ये चैव सात्त्विका भावा राजसास्तामसाश्च ये।

मत्त एवेति तान्विद्धि नत्वहं तेषु ते मयि।।7.12।।
verses.iast:
ye caiva sāttvikā bhāvā rājasāstāmasāśca ye|

matta eveti tānviddhi natvahaṃ teṣu te mayi||7.12||
verses.en: And whatever states pertaining to Sattva, and those pertaining to Rajas, and to Tamas, know them to proceed from Me alone; still I am not in them, but they are in Me.

verses.deva:
त्रिभिर्गुणमयैर्भावैरेभिः सर्वमिदं जगत्।

मोहितं नाभिजानाति मामेभ्यः परमव्ययम्।।7.13।।
verses.iast:
tribhirguṇamayairbhāvairebhiḥ sarvamidaṃ jagat|

mohitaṃ nābhijānāti māmebhyaḥ paramavyayam||7.13||
verses.en: Deluded by these states, the modifications of the three Gunas (of Prakriti), all this world does not know Me, beyond them, and immutable.

word_meanings.meaning: consisting of the modes of material nature

verses.deva:
दैवी ह्येषा गुणमयी मम माया दुरत्यया।

मामेव ये प्रपद्यन्ते मायामेतां तरन्ति ते।।7.14।।
verses.iast:
daivī hyeṣā guṇamayī mama māyā duratyayā|

māmeva ye prapadyante māyāmetāṃ taranti te||7.14||
verses.en: Verily, this divine illusion of Mine, constituted of the Gunas, is difficult to cross over; those who devote themselves to Me alone, cross over this illusion.

word_meanings.meaning: consisting of the three modes of nature
one of God’s energies. It that veils God’s true nature from souls who have not yet attained the eligibility for God-realization

verses.deva:
न मां दुष्कृतिनो मूढाः प्रपद्यन्ते नराधमाः।

माययापहृतज्ञाना आसुरं भावमाश्रिताः।।7.15।।
verses.iast:
na māṃ duṣkṛtino mūḍhāḥ prapadyante narādhamāḥ|

māyayāpahṛtajñānā āsuraṃ bhāvamāśritāḥ||7.15||
verses.en: They do not devote themselves to Me,—the evil-doers, the deluded, the lowest of men, deprived of discrimination by Mâyâ, and following the way of the Asuras.

word_meanings.meaning: one who lazily follows one’s lower nature

verses.deva:
चतुर्विधा भजन्ते मां जनाः सुकृतिनोऽर्जुन।

आर्तो जिज्ञासुरर्थार्थी ज्ञानी च भरतर्षभ।।7.16।।
verses.iast:
caturvidhā bhajante māṃ janāḥ sukṛtino'rjuna|

ārto jijñāsurarthārthī jñānī ca bharatarṣabha||7.16||
verses.en: Four kinds of virtuous men worship Me, O Arjuna,—the distressed, the seeker of knowledge, the seeker of enjoyment, and the wise, O bull among the Bhâratas.

word_meanings.meaning: those who are situated in knowledge
The best amongst the Bharatas, Arjun

verses.deva:
तेषां ज्ञानी नित्ययुक्त एकभक्ितर्विशिष्यते।

प्रियो हि ज्ञानिनोऽत्यर्थमहं स च मम प्रियः।।7.17।।
verses.iast:
teṣāṃ jñānī nityayukta ekabhakitarviśiṣyate|

priyo hi jñānino'tyarthamahaṃ sa ca mama priyaḥ||7.17||
verses.en: Of them, the wise man, ever-steadfast, (and fired) with devotion to the One, excels; for supremely dear am I to the wise, and he is dear to Me.

word_meanings.meaning: those who are situated in knowledge

verses.deva:
उदाराः सर्व एवैते ज्ञानी त्वात्मैव मे मतम्।

आस्थितः स हि युक्तात्मा मामेवानुत्तमां गतिम्।।7.18।।
verses.iast:
udārāḥ sarva evaite jñānī tvātmaiva me matam|

āsthitaḥ sa hi yuktātmā māmevānuttamāṃ gatim||7.18||
verses.en: Noble indeed are they all, but the wise man I regard as My very Self; for with the mind steadfast, he is established in Me alone, as the supreme goal.

verses.deva:
बहूनां जन्मनामन्ते ज्ञानवान्मां प्रपद्यते।

वासुदेवः सर्वमिति स महात्मा सुदुर्लभः।।7.19।।
verses.iast:
bahūnāṃ janmanāmante jñānavānmāṃ prapadyate|

vāsudevaḥ sarvamiti sa mahātmā sudurlabhaḥ||7.19||
verses.en: At the end of many births, the man of wisdom takes refuge in Me, realising that all this is Vâsudeva (the innermost Self). Very rare is that great soul.

word_meanings.meaning: one who is endowed with knowledge
Shree Krishna, the son of Vasudev

verses.deva:
कामैस्तैस्तैर्हृतज्ञानाः प्रपद्यन्तेऽन्यदेवताः।

तं तं नियममास्थाय प्रकृत्या नियताः स्वया।।7.20।।
verses.iast:
kāmaistaistairhṛtajñānāḥ prapadyante'nyadevatāḥ|

taṃ taṃ niyamamāsthāya prakṛtyā niyatāḥ svayā||7.20||
verses.en: Others again, deprived of discrimination by this or that desire, following this or that rite, devote themselves to other gods, led by their own natures.

word_meanings.meaning: whose knowledge has been carried away

verses.deva:
यो यो यां यां तनुं भक्तः श्रद्धयार्चितुमिच्छति।

तस्य तस्याचलां श्रद्धां तामेव विदधाम्यहम्।।7.21।।
verses.iast:
yo yo yāṃ yāṃ tanuṃ bhaktaḥ śraddhayārcitumicchati|

tasya tasyācalāṃ śraddhāṃ tāmeva vidadhāmyaham||7.21||
verses.en: Whatsoever form any devotee seeks to worship with Shraddhâ,—that Shraddhâ of his do I make unwavering.

verses.deva:
स तया श्रद्धया युक्तस्तस्याराधनमीहते।

लभते च ततः कामान्मयैव विहितान् हि तान्।।7.22।।
verses.iast:
sa tayā śraddhayā yuktastasyārādhanamīhate|

labhate ca tataḥ kāmānmayaiva vihitān hi tān||7.22||
verses.en: Endued with that Shraddhâ, he engages in the worship of that, and from it, gains his desires,—these being verily dispensed by Me alone.

verses.deva:
अन्तवत्तु फलं तेषां तद्भवत्यल्पमेधसाम्।

देवान्देवयजो यान्ति मद्भक्ता यान्ति मामपि।।7.23।।
verses.iast:
antavattu phalaṃ teṣāṃ tadbhavatyalpamedhasām|

devāndevayajo yānti madbhaktā yānti māmapi||7.23||
verses.en: But the fruit (accruing) to these men of little understanding is limited. The worshippers of the Devas go to the Devas; My devotees too come to me.

word_meanings.meaning: the worshipers of the celestial gods

verses.deva:
अव्यक्तं व्यक्ितमापन्नं मन्यन्ते मामबुद्धयः।

परं भावमजानन्तो ममाव्ययमनुत्तमम्।।7.24।।
verses.iast:
avyaktaṃ vyakitamāpannaṃ manyante māmabuddhayaḥ|

paraṃ bhāvamajānanto mamāvyayamanuttamam||7.24||
verses.en: The foolish regard Me, the un-manifested, as come into manifestation, not knowing My supreme state,—immutable and transcendental.

verses.deva:
नाहं प्रकाशः सर्वस्य योगमायासमावृतः।

मूढोऽयं नाभिजानाति लोको मामजमव्ययम्।।7.25।।
verses.iast:
nāhaṃ prakāśaḥ sarvasya yogamāyāsamāvṛtaḥ|

mūḍho'yaṃ nābhijānāti loko māmajamavyayam||7.25||
verses.en: Veiled by the illusion born of the congress of the Gunas, I am not manifest to all. This deluded world knows Me not, the Unborn, the Immutable.

verses.deva:
वेदाहं समतीतानि वर्तमानानि चार्जुन।

भविष्याणि च भूतानि मां तु वेद न कश्चन।।7.26।।
verses.iast:
vedāhaṃ samatītāni vartamānāni cārjuna|

bhaviṣyāṇi ca bhūtāni māṃ tu veda na kaścana||7.26||
verses.en: I know, O Arjuna, the beings of the whole past, and the present, and the future, but Me none knoweth.

verses.deva:
इच्छाद्वेषसमुत्थेन द्वन्द्वमोहेन भारत।

सर्वभूतानि संमोहं सर्गे यान्ति परन्तप।।7.27।।
verses.iast:
icchādveṣasamutthena dvandvamohena bhārata|

sarvabhūtāni saṃmohaṃ sarge yānti parantapa||7.27||
verses.en: By the delusion of the pairs of opposites, arising from desire and aversion, O descendant of Bharata, all beings fall into delusion at birth, O scorcher of foes.

verses.deva:
येषां त्वन्तगतं पापं जनानां पुण्यकर्मणाम्।

ते द्वन्द्वमोहनिर्मुक्ता भजन्ते मां दृढव्रताः।।7.28।।
verses.iast:
yeṣāṃ tvantagataṃ pāpaṃ janānāṃ puṇyakarmaṇām|

te dvandvamohanirmuktā bhajante māṃ dṛḍhavratāḥ||7.28||
verses.en: Those men of virtuous deeds, whose sin has come to an end,—they, freed from the delusion of the pairs of opposites, worship Me with firm resolve.

verses.deva:
जरामरणमोक्षाय मामाश्रित्य यतन्ति ये।

ते ब्रह्म तद्विदुः कृत्स्नमध्यात्मं कर्म चाखिलम्।।7.29।।
verses.iast:
jarāmaraṇamokṣāya māmāśritya yatanti ye|

te brahma tadviduḥ kṛtsnamadhyātmaṃ karma cākhilam||7.29||
verses.en: Those who strive for freedom from old age and death, taking refuge in Me, they know. Brahman, the whole of Adhyâtma, and Karma in its entirety.

verses.deva:
साधिभूताधिदैवं मां साधियज्ञं च ये विदुः।

प्रयाणकालेऽपि च मां ते विदुर्युक्तचेतसः।।7.30।।
verses.iast:
sādhibhūtādhidaivaṃ māṃ sādhiyajñaṃ ca ye viduḥ|

prayāṇakāle'pi ca māṃ te viduryuktacetasaḥ||7.30||
verses.en: Those who know Me with the Adhibhuta, the Adhidaiva, and the Adhiyajna, (continue to) know Me even at the time of death, steadfast in mind.

word_meanings.meaning: governing principle of the field of matter
governing principle of the celestial gods
governing principle of the Lord all sacrificial performances
